subject.title: [Bug]: TLS certificate pin mismatch loop when connecting through Cloudflare Tunnel/Access (anycast edge certs)

question: Should manually entered iOS Remote Domain endpoints without an explicitly supplied fingerprint use platform CA and hostname validation instead of automatic leaf-certificate TOFU pinning?
rationale: Cloudflare anycast certificates make automatic leaf pinning unreliable, but removing it broadly would change the gateway identity security boundary; source inspection alone cannot determine the intended permanent trust policy.

options.title: CA validation for public domains
options.body: Use platform CA and hostname validation for manually entered remote domains unless setup explicitly supplies a fingerprint, while retaining strict pinning for discovery and explicitly pinned endpoints.

options.title: Pin a stable identity
options.body: Keep pinning but derive it from a stable gateway-controlled key or certificate identity that survives reverse-proxy leaf rotation, requiring a broader protocol and setup design.

options.title: Document unsupported topology
options.body: Retain current leaf pinning and explicitly mark rotating or anycast TLS terminators as unsupported, leaving Cloudflare Tunnel and Access users without this connection path.

recommendation.title: CA validation for public domains
recommendation.body: Use platform CA and hostname validation for manually entered remote domains unless setup explicitly supplies a fingerprint, while retaining strict pinning for discovery and explicitly pinned endpoints.
